item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Hydration. Most people start the day mildly dehydrated, and it shows up as low focus and short patience. You've got a full day of structure ahead, so don't leave water to chance. Drink a full glass early, before anything else, then keep a bottle within reach and tie sips to moments you already do: after each break, each walk, each transition. Action: drink a full glass of water right now.
